key_insight: Collaborating AI agents autonomously derived and experimentally tested quantum-spin predictions while rejecting an initially inconclusive result.
engineering_relevance: Mutual review, independent checks and drift-aware acceptance criteria offer a blueprint for more reliable autonomous laboratories.
method: Agents proposed, reviewed and rejected research questions.
They derived minimum calibration requirements for a defined family of microwave pulse sequences and checked them computationally.
They designed discriminating experiments on quantum-spin ensembles in diamond and revised the protocol after detecting drift.
evidence_signal: Repeated reference measurements exposed drift in the initial experiment; a revised experiment met unchanged acceptance criteria and supported the theoretical predictions.
watch_item: Demonstration on a defined quantum-spin task does not establish reliability across other experimental platforms or research domains.
paper_title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
